original_card.first_experiment: Choose one assumption ID (native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery), one quantified implication and exact dependency closure. Check current handoffs, including #5625 row reentry and #5707 root-prefix lowering, without treating their partial scope as the whole theorem. actual_scope: Bind an optimal unbiased reversible Gaussian grid map to the first native MOVE of the selected PR6030 word. Prove the tensor error and retained-seed interface, and its fixed-grid relative-error limit.

This local map has zero conditional mean error with fresh bits, but cannot meet a uniform relative coefficient below one on a fixed grid. It is not supplier admission or a kappa change.
